description.p: RootWatch is the dev security control panel. This desktop client connects to your RootWatch instance — rootwatch.dev cloud or a self-hosted deployment — and gives you live security posture at a glance.

ul.li: Full dashboard in a native window (system metrics, security events, vulnerabilities, listening ports)
System tray indicator with a live security score
Desktop notifications for new Critical and High severity events
Org-scoped API token auth (rw_…) stored encrypted via the OS keychain
Pairs with the `rootwatch` CLI and MCP server for agent workflows

description.p: Initial release: connect to a RootWatch instance, tray score monitor, critical-event notifications.
